lessons_used: New interactive flows (new_flow) delivered the largest wins (up to +14.8%), but predictions were often overly optimistic as several variants caused severe drops (down to -11.8%).
Step reordering (reorder) drove major wins (up to +12.0%), though it carried high risk, frequently producing no clear effect or severe drops (down to -8.9%).
Wait-state information (wait_info) generated multiple solid wins (up to +6.1%), occasionally exceeding conservative predictions (+6.1% vs +3.2%), though several variants showed no clear effect.
Targeted copy updates (copy) yielded selective wins (up to +6.7%), though the majority of copy tests resulted in no clear effect.
UI redesigns (redesign) frequently caused severe drops (down to -19.3%), but a companion selection layout redesign produced a major win (+8.5%), vastly outperforming pessimistic predictions (-5.0%).

Hints (hint), notifications (notification), layout changes (layout), and standalone preview screens (new_screen) failed to produce any wins, with hints sometimes worsening performance (down to -3.1%).

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Pet Shortcut Sandbox Flow
candidates.change: Adds an interactive desktop shortcut sandbox on the home intro screen where users practice summoning and toggling pet visibility.
candidates.why: Support emails show 3 users reported pets not displaying or app not opening, while 3 emails reported confusion on how to control or hide the pet. Finish step drops to 73.5%.

components.text: Press shortcut anytime on desktop to show or hide your pet.

guard.reason: Adding interactive shortcut practice components to the home intro screen is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: High drop step and support emails point here, but finish new_flows historically show negative performance.

candidates.title: Desktop Graphics Status & Preparation Timer
candidates.change: Displays desktop graphics readiness checks and a countdown status indicator on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Home waiting screen has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing drop-offs before completion. Support emails reported 3 instances of pet desktop display failures.

guard.reason: Adding readiness checks and a timer to the waiting screen is permitted as it represents a real wait during pet preparation.

candidates.score_note: Strong alignment between high wait duration, support emails, and highly reliable wait_info history.

candidates.title: Two-Column Split Layout for Photo Upload Stage
candidates.change: Rebuilds the photo upload stage into a split two-column layout separating photo guidelines from upload actions.
candidates.why: Adoption step has an 83.5% conversion with 1017s mean duration, and 3 support tickets reported custom pet photo errors.

photo_upload.text: Upload clear front-facing pet photos for accurate 3D generation.

guard.reason: replacement for 'upload_photos.photo_upload' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['photo_picker'] with real words

candidates.title: Multi-Device Account Retrieval Sign-In Copy
candidates.change: Clarifies that signing in restores existing pets across devices and prevents accidental pet resets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails (the top support theme) reported pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.body: Sign in to keep your pet saved safely in the cloud and access your adoption history on any desktop device.
sign_in.headline: Protect & Sync Your Desktop Companion

guard.reason: Updating sign-in copy to clarify sync and account protection preserves the sign-in step's function.

candidates.score_note: Addresses the top support email complaint via a zero-cost copy change with strong positive history.

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Trait Confirmation Sandbox Flow
candidates.change: Adds an interactive trait confirmation sandbox on the adoption certificate screen where users test pet behaviors before finishing adoption.
candidates.why: Adoption step takes 1017s mean time with 83.5% conversion, and users express confusion after onboarding about pet control.

components.text: Preview how your pet greets you when desktop active.

guard.reason: Adding interactive trait preview components to the adoption certificate screen retains the certificate and its stamp.

candidates.score_note: Targets high mean adoption time; adoption new_flows have positive historical performance but high dev cost.

candidates.title: Card Grid Redesign for Companion Friend Picker
candidates.change: Redesign companion selection stage into a structured card grid highlighting pet attributes and desktop compatibility.
candidates.why: Adoption step conversion is 83.5% with high mean duration (1017s). Stage layout redesign previously yielded +8.5% conversion.

guard.reason: Redesigning the friend picker into a card grid retains the ability for users to choose a pet.

candidates.score_note: Redesigns carry severe drop risk and historical adoption redesigns averaged -7.2%.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Render Queue Progress Breakdown
candidates.change: Shows structured render queue milestones and live preparation tips on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Home step duration is high (mean 2336s, median 201s). Wait-state info updates previously produced wins up to +6.1%.

components.text: Your pet will automatically anchor to your screen dock once complete.

guard.reason: Adding progress breakdown milestones to the waiting screen maintains the function of showing that the pet is being prepared.

candidates.score_note: Reliable wait_info approach targeting long duration at the home step.

candidates.title: Path Expectation & Setup Time Clarity Copy
candidates.change: Updates choose path headline and hint to clarify initial setup duration and outcome expectations.
candidates.why: Choose path is the lowest first-run step conversion (78.3%), with a high mean time of 514s.

choose_path.body: Select your journey type. Quick companion setup takes under 2 minutes.
choose_path.headline: Choose Your Onboarding Path
choose_path.hint: You can modify companion settings anytime from the system tray.

guard.reason: Updating choose path copy provides setup time expectations without altering the requirement to offer both adopting and making your own pet.

candidates.score_note: Targeting the lowest early step conversion with a simple, low-cost copy change.

candidates.title: Split Stage Redesign for Story Intro Screen
candidates.change: Redesigns the story onboarding screen into a split stage format balancing narrative text with companion visuals.
candidates.why: Choose path target step has drop-off (78.3% conversion, 514s mean time). Redesigning early stages improves initial momentum.

intro_story.text: Welcome to your desktop companion journey.

guard.reason: replacement for 'story.intro_story' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'mascot', 'video'] with an asset:story/ asset

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Docking Practice Flow
candidates.change: Adds an interactive pet docking practice mini-flow on home intro letting users practice dragging and docking the companion.
candidates.why: Finish step conversion drops to 73.5% (mean 5815s) and 3 support emails reported confusion controlling the desktop pet.

components.text: Drag your pet to any desktop edge to snap it into place.

guard.reason: Adding interactive pet docking practice components to the home intro screen is valid inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Clear evidence from finish drop and support mails, but finish new_flows historically fail to lift conversion.

lessons_next: Interactive new flows (new_flow) delivered the largest wins (up to +14.8%), but predictions were often overly optimistic as several variants caused severe drops (down to -11.8%) or guardrail rollbacks.
Step reordering (reorder) drove major wins (up to +12.0%), though it carried high risk, frequently producing no clear effect or severe drops (down to -8.9%).
UI redesigns (redesign) frequently caused severe drops (down to -19.3%), but a companion selection redesign yielded a major win (+8.5%), vastly outperforming pessimistic predictions (-5.0%).
Wait-state information (wait_info) produced multiple solid wins (up to +6.1%), occasionally exceeding conservative predictions (+6.1% vs +3.2%), though several variants showed no clear effect.
Targeted copy updates (copy) yielded selective wins (up to +6.7%), particularly around account protection and retrieval, though the majority resulted in no clear effect.

Hints (hint), notifications (notification), layout changes (layout), and standalone preview screens (new_screen) failed to produce any wins, with hints sometimes worsening performance (down to -3.1%).
